title: She Demanded My Window Seat for Her 30-Year-Old Son…
hook: She demanded my window seat… for her 30-year-old son
story: A woman on my flight demanded I give up my window seat so her son could see the clouds. Her son was about thirty years old. I said no, politely. She called me selfish loud enough for the whole plane to hear, then pressed the call button. The flight attendant listened to her whole speech, looked at my boarding pass, and asked me to grab my bag. My stomach dropped. I thought I was getting kicked off. Instead, she walked me straight up to first class. "We had an empty seat," she whispered, "and you've been very patient." Then she walked back and told the woman, "Good news. The window seat is free." Her son slid over, thrilled. But here's the best part. His old seat was now empty, and she'd planned to put her bags there. So the attendant gave it to the next person on standby. A man with a terrible cold, and a tuna sandwich. For five hours. I had warm cookies. And every time I walked past to the bathroom… she pretended to be asleep.
description:
Patience pays. Sometimes in first class. ✈️

New story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss part 2s. 🔔
